Amazon Acquires AI Chip Optimization Tech from Startup Decart

Amazon announced on Monday its intention to acquire the technology of AI startup Decart, along with its founders and other staff. The deal aims to secure AI talent and technology, a trend seen in recent Big Tech acquisitions. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed by Amazon, though Bloomberg reported the deal to be worth $7.5 billion. Neither company immediately responded to requests for comment.
